changelog:
Initial release of 3d-generator.

- Enables AI-generated 3D models using leading APIs such as TripoAI and Meshy.
- Supports 3D model generation from text prompts, single image, and multi-view images.
- Provides two main API endpoints: create a generation task and poll task progress.
- Output includes downloadable 3D models (.obj, .pbr, .glb) and preview images.
- Comprehensive documentation with examples and quick start instructions.
summary: AI Generated 3D Models using SOTA APIs such as Tripo/Meshy/TripoSR/etc served on OneKey Agent Gateway by Craftsman Agent, useful for AI Game, Figurine, Stuffed Toy Generation
